findings.message: The decoded audio of the block at 0x34BA does not have the CRC its header stores (the block's data ends early or holds samples libwavpack takes for corrupt, so it is muted).
The MD5 of the decoded audio is 3f51a2dbe745a6cf967d52544483b2ff, but the file stores 33f110d8eb91888849a451b5f07f99a7: the audio differs from what the encoder read.
